description: Searchable, citation-grounded CIVPAY answers (domestic SOP#1 + overseas/special-category SOP#2). Every row cites an official source (DCPS R26-1, DCPDS, DoD FMR Vol 8, 5 CFR, OPM GPPA, DSSR, DoDI 1400.25). No row ships without a Citation.
